title: Prepare Stock Plates for Indexing with Universal Illumina Primers
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter pipetting parameters
steps.instruction: Input reduced pipetting flow rate for the master mix (µL/sec), aspirate and dispense delay times (seconds), well‑bottom clearances (mm), and select labware for 200 µL tips, reagent reservoir and PCR plates.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated Opentrons protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the Opentrons App (OT App).

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the reagent reservoir, 200 µL tip rack, the 96‑well primer plate, and the nine PCR plates in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the tip rack, reagent reservoir, primer plate, and PCR plates, as well as the p300 multi‑channel pipette, following the app’s calibration protocol.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the robot program.

steps.title: Suspend primers and dispense to plates
steps.instruction: The robot uses a p300 multi‑channel pipette to suspend each column of indexing primers (from the 96‑well PCR plate) in master mix (in the reagent reservoir), then distributes 14 µL of this mixture to the matching column of each of the nine PCR plates, repeating for all columns to fill every column of the nine plates. Liquid‑handling settings: use a reduced (slow) flow rate for aspiration and dispense, include a pause after each aspiration and dispense until liquid motion stops, avoid introducing air (do not perform complete dispenses), dispense onto the well surface, and withdraw the tip slowly from the liquid.
